Fresh sourdough bread baked every morning

Sunrise Bakery is a small family bakery in the old town that bakes sourdough bread, croissants and seasonal pastries every morning before dawn.

Our sourdough bread is fermented for thirty six hours with organic flour from local mills, which gives every loaf a deep flavor and a crunchy crust.

Besides bread, the bakery prepares cakes for birthdays and weddings, and a catering service with pastries and sandwiches for offices and events.

You can visit the bakery from Tuesday to Sunday, order bread online for pickup, or join one of the weekend sourdough baking workshops for beginners.

Every evening the bread that was not sold is donated to the community kitchen of the neighborhood, so nothing baked in our ovens goes to waste.

Sunrise Bakery · 12 Old Town Street · Open Tuesday to Sunday
